basic_info.description: Step into this ultra-chic, full-floor 2BD/2BA residence in a thoughtfully renovated three-unit building located directly across from Golden Gate Park. With soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and wide-plank wood floors, the home strikes a perfect balance between modern updates and warm, timeless materials.    The open-concept living space is anchored by a sleek chef's kitchen featuring custom European walnut cabinetry, Pental quartz countertops, a designer tile backsplash, and a full suite of Bosch appliances. Just off the kitchen, the airy living and dining areas offer seamless flow for both entertaining and everyday living, complete with a gas fireplace and a wall of windows that frame the park's greenery.    The serene primary suite opens to a private rear deck and includes a spa-like bath with designer tile and a floating vanity. Additional highlights include hydronic radiant floor heating, in-unit side-by-side laundry, and one-car off-street parking.    Centrally located near the shops and restaurants of NOPA and the Haight, with convenient access to USF, UCSF, and multiple transit options, this home makes it easy to enjoy both city life and the outdoors. You're right where you want to be.
